semantic.justification: Task0V5WR6 connects the production Calc route to actual ScDocument,ScViewData and ScDocShell owners through shared SfxObjectShell,SfxUndoManager,SfxInterface,SfxViewFrame,dispatcher and command bindings. Controlled React presenters reuse Writer toolbar styles,Tailwind,Lucide and global fonts. The supported slice includes plain scalar/native local-A1 input,recalculation,cancel,selection,name-box navigation,sheet append/switch,typed token-valued undo/redo and bounded browser viewport projection. Compiled formula adoption retains code errors in history;sheet deletion ends formula subscriptions and renumbers source cells. One real model owns cells;browser state contains transient input/geometry only. This is a bounded editable workspace,not full Calc/native parity.
